# Davies Kelly

> Davies Kelly is a Dubai-based firm of independent quantum and delay experts for construction and engineering disputes. Its experts give written and oral expert evidence in international arbitration, court proceedings and adjudication across the Middle East, Africa, Asia and Europe, and it also reviews claims and advises on contracts before and during disputes. When appointed as experts, its people owe their duty to the tribunal or court.

## Experts
- [Michael Roos](https://davieskelly.com/experts/michael-roos/): founding partner and testifying quantum expert; BSc (Hons) Quantity Surveying (Glasgow Caledonian University), LLM Construction Law, Arbitration and Adjudication (Robert Gordon University), MCIArb; prolongation, disruption, head office overheads, variations, defects and final accounts; Middle East, North Africa, UK and Europe.
- [Jamie Shafto](https://davieskelly.com/experts/jamie-shafto/): founding partner and testifying delay expert; appointed in ICC and DIAC arbitrations; oral evidence under cross-examination by King's Counsel; forensic delay and disruption analysis; UK and MENA.
- [Stephen M John](https://davieskelly.com/experts/stephen-john/): Eur Ing, chartered civil engineer, FICE, FCIArb, MCIHT; independent technical and FIDIC contract evidence.
- [Michael Whiting](https://davieskelly.com/experts/michael-whiting/): quantity surveyor supporting the quantum experts; BSc (Hons) Quantity Surveying, RICS Expert Witness Certificate.

## Services
- [Quantum expert evidence](https://davieskelly.com/services/quantum/): prolongation, disruption (including measured mile), head office overheads, variations, liquidated damages, defects counterclaims, final accounts.
- [Delay expert evidence](https://davieskelly.com/services/delay/): forensic delay analysis, disruption, extension of time entitlement, independent determinations.
- [Claim review and advisory](https://davieskelly.com/services/advisory/): independent claim reviews, claim preparation and defence, contract and project advice. Kept separate from expert appointments.

## How we work
- [Independence](https://davieskelly.com/independence/): duty to the tribunal; seven conduct rules; conflict checks before documents; one role per dispute; client matters are never named.
- [Experience](https://davieskelly.com/experience/): anonymised matters by sector, region, forum and role.
